import numpy as np, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import numpy as np, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']); O=np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])

    base=np.where(C_==2,1,C_)
    base=np.where(base==3,1,base)
    base=np.where(base==4,1,base)
    diff=np.sum(base!=Oi)
    # also score marker-only diffs

import numpy as np, os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# demo2: frame rows1-9 cols10-18 (9x9). markers: 4 at (13,5), 5 at (13,10), 8 at (19,5).
I2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']); O2=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])
fr2=I2[1:10,10:19]; inn2=fr2[1:-1,1:-1]; Oi2=O2[1:-1,1:-1]
print('demo2 markers:',[(13,5,4),(13,10,5),(19,5,8)])
# output interior Oi2 vs dihedral of inn2, diffs:
for nm,C in [('id',inn2),('r90',np.rot90(inn2)),('r180',np.rot90(inn2,2)),('r270',np.rot90(inn2,3)),
             ('T',inn2.T),('anti',inn2.T[::-1,:]),('flipud',inn2[::-1,:]),('fliplr',inn2[:,::-1])]:
    d=[(i,j,int(C[i,j]),int(Oi2[i,j])) for i in range(C.shape[0]) for j in range(C.shape[1]) if C[i,j]!=Oi2[i,j]]
    # classify: marker-colored (in {2,4,5,8}) vs pattern-colored
    mk=[x for x in d if x[2] in (2,4,5,8) and x[3] not in (2,4,5,8)]
    pat=[x for x in d if x[2]==8 and x[3]==1]
    print(nm,'ndiff',len(d),'markers painted',mk,'pattern-swapped',pat[:5])

# Verify hypothesis across all demos: which dihedral of the whole frame block reproduces output EXACTLY (pattern + markers)?
def frame_of(bi):
    ones=np.argwhere(bi==1)
    r0,r1=int(ones[:,0].min()),int(ones[:,0].max()); c0,c1=int(ones[:,1].min()),int(ones[:,1].max())
    return bi[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
D=[('d1',np.array(G['Demo pair 1 input']),np.array(G['Demo pair 1 output'])),
   ('d2',np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input']),np.array(G['Demo pair 2 output'])),
   ('d3',np.array(G['Demo pair 3 input']),np.array(G['Demo pair 3 output']))]
for dn,bi,bo in D:
    fb=frame_of(bi); bo_=bo.copy()
    dihs={'id':fb,'T':fb.T,'fu':fb[::-1,:],'fl':fb[:,::-1],
          'r90':np.rot90(fb),'r180':fb[::-1,::-1],'r270':np.rot90(fb,k=-1)}
    good=[nm for nm,v in dihs.items() if v.shape==bo_.shape and (v==bo_).all()]
    print(dn,'frame',fb.shape,'out',bo_.shape,'EXACT diheds:',good, '| T-only?',('T' in good))

    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

# For each demo: markers sit just outside the frame on one side; find which dihedral of block reproduces O EXACTLY (incl marker cells) and report mapping.
def all_diheds(b):
    return {'r90':np.rot90(b),'r180':np.rot90(b,2),'r270':np.rot90(b,3),
            'fu':b[::-1,:],'fl':b[:,::-1],'r90f':np.rot90(b,1)[::-1,:],
            'r90g':np.rot90(b,1)[:,::-1],'r180f':np.rot90(b,2)[::-1,:],
            'r270f':np.rot90(b,3)[::-1,:]}
for n,b,O in D:
    blk=fb(b)
    exact=[k for k,v in all_diheds(blk).items() if v.shape==O.shape and (v==O).all()]
    # marker positions rel to frame bbox edges
    o=np.argwhere(b==1); r0,r1=int(o[:,0].min()),int(o[:,0].max()); c0,c1=int(o[:,1].min()),int(o[:,1].max())
    mpos=[]
    for r in range(b.shape[0]):
        for c in range(b.shape[1]):
            if not(r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1) and b[r][c]!=0:
                dr = -(r-r0+1) if r<r0 else (r1-r+1)   # above -> neg, below -> pos distance
                dc = -(c-c0+1) if c<c0 else (c1-c+1)
                mpos.append((int(b[r][c]),'A' if dr<0 else 'B','L' if dc<0 else 'R',dr,dc))
    print(n,'exact dihedrals:',exact,'markers(color,sidexside,distrow,distcol):',mpos)

import numpy as np
def frame_block(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape
    # find row-range & col-range where every row has 1s at both ends forming closed ring
    for r0 in range(H):
        for r1 in range(r0,H):
            sub=I[r0:r1+1,:]
            rows_ok=all((sub[i,:]==1).sum()==2 for i in range(sub.shape[0]))
            if not rows_ok: continue
            cols=sub[:,0]==1 | sub[:,-1]==1
            # need exactly two columns fully 1 (left&right edges) for middle rows; top/bottom rows may have more
            mid=[i for i in range(1,sub.shape[0]-1)]
            edge_cols=[c for c in range(W) if all((sub[i,c]==1) for i in mid)]
            if len(edge_cols)!=2: continue
            c0=min(edge_cols); c1=max(edge_cols)
            if (sub[0,c0:c1+1]).all()==False or (sub[-1,c0:c1+1]).all()==False: continue
            if (sub[:,c0]).all() and (sub[:,c1]).all():
                return I[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1]
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I=np.array(G[name+' input'])
    blk=frame_block(I)
    print(name,'blk',blk.shape)
    fns={'id':blk,'r90':np.rot90(blk,-1),'r180':np.rot90(blk,2),'r270':np.rot90(blk),
        'fliph':np.fliplr(blk),'flipv':np.flipud(blk),'trans':blk.T,'anti':np.rot90(blk).T}
    O=np.array(G[name+' output'])
    good=[nm for nm,f in fns.items() if f.shape==O.shape and (f==O).all()]
    print('  out',O.shape,'match:',good)
